name: Securities Settlement System Identification 2
definition: Specifies the securities settlement system used in a settlement process.

SystemIdentification.name: System Identification
SystemIdentification.definition: Identification of the securities settlement system.

SystemName.name: System Name
SystemName.definition: Name of the securities settlement system.

CountryOfJurisdiction.name: Country Of Jurisdiction
CountryOfJurisdiction.definition: Country code for the jurisdiction in which the CSD is established.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification of the CSD operating the securities settlement system.

ResponsibleParty.name: Responsible Party
ResponsibleParty.definition: Party (such as a person or a team) responsible for the report sent by the CSD.
